name: french_plural_conjugation
description: French present-tense regular -er verb agreement with nous/vous; control copies the infinitive from the same sentence.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
a=[];c=[]
verbs='parler chanter danser aimer regarder jouer travailler marcher penser trouver porter donner'.split()
for i in range(120):
 v=random.choice(verbs);p=random.choice(['nous','vous']);s=f'Infinitif: {v}. Sujet: {p}. '
 a.append({'prompt':s+'Complétez au présent: '+p,'answer':' '+v[:-2]+('ons' if p=='nous' else 'ez')})
 c.append({'prompt':s+'Recopiez l\'infinitif:','answer':' '+v})
json.dump({'items':a,'control':c},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
